name: The Twelve Days of Christmas
source:
The Twelve Days of Christmas is about Amy and her boyfriend drawn away from their little town to the bright lights of the big city. They need to find jobs and a place to stay. Unfortunately, Amy's father doesn't approve and she is tricked into promising that the couple will earn $10,000 by Christmas or she will return home and marry someone else. An impossible task, but maybe, if she can manage her love points wisely, it can be done.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/SlowBurnGames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《The Twelve Days of Christmas》讲述艾米与男友离开小镇，被大都市的璀璨灯火吸引的故事。他们需要找工作，也需要找住处。可艾米的父亲并不赞同，还骗她许下承诺，必须在圣诞节之前赚到一万美元，否则，她就得回家，嫁给别人。这几乎是不可能完成的任务。不过，只要明智地运用恋爱点数，也许，仍有成功的机会。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/SlowBurnGames]Patreon[/url]]
